selection_reason: Hardware-Aware TransformersはSuperTransformerのweight sharingとhardware latency constraint付きevolutionary searchでtarget CPU/GPU/IoT向けSubTransformerを選び、低遅延推論を直接最適化する。WMT'14でRaspberry Pi 4上baseline Transformer比3倍高速・3.7倍小型、Evolved Transformer比2.7倍高速・3.6倍小型を性能低下なしで報告するため対象内。
title: HAT: Hardware-Aware Transformers for Efficient Natural Language Processing
